The female boxer is a subject that is not yet fully defined in the sociological sense.

the female boxer is a figure of potential and vulnerability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which we can read the female boxer as both a social construct and as an embodied experience.
how art can be a site of intervention and a way to understand a body that is not yet defined.
the female body in the context of boxing, and how this body has become an important signifier for gender and identity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the female boxer in art is a figure that can be understood as a site of vacillations and contradictions that are not necessarily reconcilable or even desirable to be reconciled.

my project has demonstrated that the female boxer is not only a figure of vulnerability, but that the female boxing body has been utilized as a figure of vulnerability in order to represent and to signify.
the boxing body, as a site of potential, is an ideal subject to investigate through art and theory.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are looking at a particular body, the female boxer, as an example of the ways in which bodies are constructed and understood, and how this is reflected in the ways in that they are represented in art.
the boxing body is a body in motion, a body that is not yet defined, a body that has the potential for many different definitions and meanings.
we are interested in the female boxer as an example of a body in movement that is both a signifier for a sociological subject and a body that exceeds the definition of that subject.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we are able to understand the female boxer as both an object and a subject, and that this understanding is necessary to the ways in which we can understand the boxing body as it is being represented in contemporary culture.
the female boxer is not a stable signifier; rather, the female boxer is a subject that is constantly becoming, a subject that is always in the midst of its own becoming.
the female boxer is a subject that can and should be considered in its plurality.
